documents.unit: Office of the Vice Provost for Education (AI Council)
documents.title: Tufts Generative AI Usage Guidelines for Faculty, Staff, and Students
documents.summary: Adopted by the Tufts AI Council in spring 2026, these university guidelines offer shared principles on accountability, ethics and privacy, transparency and disclosure, and clarity of expectations. They deliberately leave AI-use decisions to schools, departments and instructors, and discourage AI detectors as the main basis for integrity decisions.
documents.stance_why: The page sets no university-wide stance on AI use itself. It calls itself 'deliberately non-prescriptive', tells schools and units to write their own policies, and says faculty 'may require AI use, permit it with conditions, discourage it, or prohibit it'. The decision is handed to instructors, so delegates.
